name: atlas-south
description: Atlas South Technical Services — website rebuild (monorepo)

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/web && npm run build --workspace=apps/api
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=apps/web --if-present && npm run lint --workspace=apps/api --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/web --if-present && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/api --if-present
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=apps/web --if-present && npm run test --workspace=apps/api --if-present
